name: Basic unilateral CVA = (1−R)·∫₀ᵀ EE(u)·e^(−ru)·h(u)·S(u) du
description: Unilateral CVA as a recovery-adjusted exposure integral against the hazard default density, with closed form for constant exposure and hazard.

code.lean:
import MathFin.FixedIncome.CVA

open MathFin

/-- Unilateral CVA as a recovery-adjusted exposure integral against the hazard default density, with closed form for constant exposure and hazard. -/
theorem mf_credit_cva_unilateral {E₀ R r h₀ T : ℝ} (hrh : r + h₀ ≠ 0) :
    cva (fun _ => E₀) R r (fun _ => h₀) T =
      (1 - R) * E₀ * (h₀ / (r + h₀)) * (1 - Real.exp (-(r + h₀) * T)) :=
  MathFin.cva_const_const hrh
